description: This file declares functions for encoding and decoding variable-length integers (varints), typical in serialization or data compression methods.

methods.name: encode_varint
methods.description: Encodes a 64-bit unsigned integer into a varint format, storing the result in the provided buffer.

methods.name: decode_varint
methods.description: Decodes a varint-encoded integer from the input buffer, returning the 64-bit unsigned integer.
